title: androsace alpina var. mathildae
intro: Androsace alpina var. mathildae, commonly known as Rock Jasmine or Alpine Rose, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Primulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Androsace alpina var. mathildae are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
